svg.title: Astronomer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as astronomer, wearing a plain work shirt. Visible work cue: A long inclined optical telescope has a small eyepiece and three distinct tripod legs. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
